art_direction: 珠薄荷底灰珊瑚双眼，右侧弧碗更开，清醒正视。
composition_variation: Give the right bowl a comfortably open rounded base and the lower left eye an opening fifteen percent shallower. Keep both upper lids moderately thin and gently curved. Large black pupils join the lids and face forward, framed below by identical muted coral iris bands. Use short natural tapers at the corners and one narrow elongated ivory highlight inside each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
